text:
[Council File 26-0873]
[Items for which Public Hearings Have Not Been Held - (10 Votes Required for Consideration)]
PUBLIC SAFETY COMMITTEE REPORT relative to the selection of Fleet Works Corporation, dba Hollywood Car Carrier Service, to provide Official Police Garage towing and storage services for Service Area 2.
Recommendation for Council action:
APPROVE the selection of Fleet Works Corporation, dba Hollywood Car Carrier Service, as the Official Police Garage for Service Area 2.
AUTHORIZE the President of the Board of Police Commissioners, or designee, to negotiate and execute an Official Police Garage Towing and Storage Agreement for Service Area 2 with Fleet Works Corporation, dba Hollywood Car Carrier Service.
Fiscal Impact Statement:
None submitted by the Board of Police Commissioners. Neither the City Administrative Officer nor the Chief Legislative Analyst has completed a financial analysis of this report.
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted
summary: Council is asked to approve Fleet Works Corporation, doing business as Hollywood Car Carrier Service, as the official police garage for towing and storage in Service Area 2.

details.applicant: Fleet Works Corporation, dba Hollywood Car Carrier Service

outcome.text: Council adopted item, subject to reconsideration, pursuant to Council Rule 51 (Oct 20, 2026); Council action final
